findings: Same R9-400 checkpoint/fixed16: learned Q correction versus anchor-only adds PC+0.250 (4 wins,12 ties,0 losses; paired CI[.0625,.500]); gains VP015/017/025/027.
Normal versus anchor-only: SA mean unchanged (1 win,14 ties,1 loss); VP017 rises2to3, VP015 falls4to3. Joint falls7to6 solely VP015 although its PC rises4to5.

Correct versus unrelated reasoning: PC3.875 versus3.6875, +.1875 (3 wins,13 ties,0 losses; CI[0,.375]); gains VP010/017/026. SA3.1875 versus3.125, +.0625 (VP034 only; CI[0,.1875]); Joint6 versus4, gains VP010/034 with no losses.

This is positive paired evidence for the correct-reasoning condition on these16, with own image/request/native T5/negative C retained. It changes both input anchors and learned readout; it does not isolate a learned-Q-specific semantic benefit.

Only VP017 overlaps the PC wins over both anchor-only and unrelated. VP015/025/027 retain the normal PC score under unrelated reasoning; VP010/026 retain the normal PC score under anchor-only. The two contrasts have different case support, and cannot simply be added or assigned to one mechanism.

Normal/empty16 SA and Joint are identical case-by-case (3.1875 and6/16). PC means both3.875,1win14ties1loss,CI[-.1875,.1875]: normal winsVP0274to5 and losesVP0044to3. Normal has10 PCpasses versus empty11.

Normal versus no_c16: PC3.875 versus3.625,+.250(4 wins12ties0losses,CI[.0625,.4375]), gainsVP002/015/017/025. SA3.1875 versus3.250,-.0625onlyVP025; Jointidentical6/16casewise. All four PC wins remain SA failures under normal conditioning.

All four normal/no_c PC wins retain the same normal PC value under empty reasoning. Extra reasoning text is not required for these observed PC gains; empty still retains own image/request-context Qwen features and explicit request readout.

Anchor/no_c PC net0: VP002+1 andVP027-1; SA-.0625(+VP015,-VP017/-VP025). Learned correction recoversVP027 anchor harm, addsPC onVP015/017/025, recoversVP017 SA but losesVP015 anchor Joint. These are same-checkpoint intervention arithmetic, not independent trained-component effects.
Normal40 PC3.600 remains below R1 3.625; same16 module evidence does not establish full40 replacement.
Normal versus global train-meanC: PC3.875 versus3.9375, -.0625 (1win13ties2losses; CI[-.25,.125]); SA3.1875 versus3.125, +.0625 (1win15ties0losses). All pass counts and casewise Joint are identical.
Globalmean-to-normal changes: VP004 PC4to3, VP025 PC3to4, VP026 PC5to4; VP017 SA2to3. The normal condition has no net PC advantage over empty reasoning or global train-meanC.

All five controls are complete. The branch has a positive normal/no_c PC effect but the incremental physical benefit of scene-specific reasoning and C is unproven. MeanC still feeds state-dependent fusion; generic conditioning is not constant video output.
Neither normal40 PC3.600 nor the tiny normal60 PC gain of .016667 and unchanged14/28/13 pass counts establish the requested joint PC/SA/visual/module success. No adoption or extension.

selected_visual_evidence.scope: Same-checkpoint correction suppresses visible water-sheet artifact in sampledframes; full requested lift not clearly shown. Correct-input causation unproven.

contrast_semantics.reasoning_swapped: Only positive reasoning text is replaced; own image/request, native T5 and own negative C remain; Qwen features are recomputed in that own context. Both C_anchor and learned correction may change.
contrast_semantics.anchor_only: Learned projection contribution is removed in both CFG arms; own input-derived anchors remain.
contrast_semantics.empty_reasoning: Own image/request/native T5/negative C retained. Four empty relation delimiters have contextual Qwen states used as anchor words; R9 also explicitly reads own request words. This removes extra reasoning sentences, not all Qwen information.
contrast_semantics.global_train_mean: Training-only meanC separately for positive/negative CFG; both fixed across evaluation samples. Native image/request/T5 and video-state queries remain.

selected_reasoning_visual_evidence.scope: Existing matched correct/unrelated frames differ in contact/shape; no claim of full process correctness or isolated learned-Q content credit.
